find:
const refused = resetting()
    if (refused !== null) return refused
title: is refused while the engine data is being reset
why: The retry not checked against the reset (issue 562): a Try again pressed during a reset of the engine's data starts an engine that writes into the folders being removed.

title: cancels every request the page has with the engine at once, as its own cancel cancels each
why: The requests the engine already has left running: a window closed twice over the quit's question leaves a layout going in the engine with no page to hear it.

title: holds the cancel of every request for one the guard is still thinking about
why: A request the guard is still thinking about passed over: it is sent to the engine a moment after the window that asked for it was closed, and nothing stops it.

title: refuses it before anything reaches the engine, and releases the mark
why: The bridge without the read-only answer (issue 633): a map.build for a project a later version wrote reaches the engine, which rewrites that version's map under out/<id>.

title: lets a map.build through for a project this version wrote
why: The same check skipped, seen beside a project this version wrote: both map.builds reach the engine, not only the current one.

title: refuses when the read-only answer does not come in time, as the record lookup does
why: A lapse of the read-only lookup not read as one: the refusal says the project is read-only when the disk never said so, where a lapse says the project could not be read in time.

title: marks the project before it asks, so an export or a deletion begun meanwhile is refused
why: beginRequest moved after the read-only lookup: an export or a deletion begun while the store is asked whether a later version wrote the project meets no mark and starts.

title: is yes only for a record it reads from a later version, and never rejects
why: The store answering read-only for any record it can read: every map.build for a project this version wrote would be refused.

title: answers after a deletion sent before it
why: readOnly asked outside the project's queue: it answers from the record as it was before the writes sent ahead of it, a deletion among them.
